name: demo-to-product-model
title_zh: 从 Demo 代码反推页面、字段、状态
tagline_zh: 当你的 Demo 跑通了、PRD 还没影，它把 git commit。
tagline_en: Demo runs, PRD missing? It mines commits, UI, and fields into a reviewable model—flagging every state, permission.
desc_en: 将产品 Demo 开发资料、迭代沟通、git commit 和 Demo 代码逆向为可审阅的 Product Model。用于从 Demo 抽取页面、功能、字段、状态、流程、数据、权限、冲突和待确认问题；不负责一次性生成完整 PRD 或原型，后续可交给 product-model-to-prd。
why_zh: 不是从零写需求，而是逆向已有实现——把代码里已定型的页面、数据、流程抽成结构化模型。
why_en: It doesn't invent specs—it extracts what's already built. Turns working demo code into a structured model, so reviews start from.
limit_zh: 只吃 Demo 开发资料、迭代沟通和 git commit，不读设计稿或 PRD 旧档。
limit_en: Only ingests demo dev docs, iteration chats, and git commits—no design files or legacy PRDs. Output is a draft Product Model, not full.
title_en: Reverse-engineer a Product Model from demo code & commits
